import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("tests/codegen/types/static_property_hash.rs")
s = p.read_text()
old = '''foreach (S::$store as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, ";"; }
echo "\\n";
unset(S::$store["a"]);
var_dump(count(S::$store), array_keys(S::$store));
"#,'''
new = '''foreach (S::$store as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, ";"; }
echo "\\n";
var_dump(array_keys(S::$store), array_values(S::$store));
"#,'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''         a=over;b=2;\\n\\
         int(1)\\n\\
         array(1) {\\n  [0]=>\\n  string(1) \\"b\\"\\n}\\n"'''
new = '''         a=over;b=2;\\n\\
         array(2) {\\n  [0]=>\\n  string(1) \\"a\\"\\n  [1]=>\\n  string(1) \\"b\\"\\n}\\n\\
         array(2) {\\n  [0]=>\\n  string(4) \\"over\\"\\n  [1]=>\\n  string(1) \\"2\\"\\n}\\n"'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("test trimmed to this change's scope")
PY
